name: Diffusive INR (DINR)
definition: A diffusive computed tomography (CT) inversion framework for regularizing Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) using a pretrained diffusion prior, designed for high-quality sparse-view parallel-beam neutron CT reconstruction.
summary: Diffusive INR is a sparse-view CT reconstruction method that regularizes implicit neural representations with a diffusion model to suppress noise and artifacts, offering resolution-independent and memory-efficient results.
